description: A shell library providing functions for handling git merge and diff tools, including configuration, tool selection, and execution logic.

methods.name: mode_ok
methods.description: Checks if the current mode is suitable for diff or merge operations.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Checks if a given merge tool is available in the system.

methods.name: list_config_tools
methods.description: Lists configured tools under a specific section in git config.

methods.name: show_tool_names
methods.description: Displays available tool names with optional preamble and filtering conditions.

methods.name: diff_mode
methods.description: Returns true if the current TOOL_MODE is 'diff'.

methods.name: merge_mode
methods.description: Returns true if the current TOOL_MODE is 'merge'.

methods.name: get_gui_default
methods.description: Determines default GUI setting based on configuration and display environment.

methods.name: gui_mode
methods.description: Returns true if the GUI mode is enabled for the current merge tool.

methods.name: translate_merge_tool_path
methods.description: Translates a tool name into its executable or path.

methods.name: check_unchanged
methods.description: Checks if the merge result is unchanged, prompting the user if needed.

methods.name: valid_tool
methods.description: Validates if a given tool name is usable.

methods.name: setup_user_tool
methods.description: Sets up a user-defined tool's commands and variants.

methods.name: setup_tool
methods.description: Initializes a tool with default behaviors and loads configuration.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_cmd
methods.description: Retrieves the command line for a specified merge tool.

methods.name: trust_exit_code
methods.description: Determines whether to trust the exit code of a tool based on configuration.

methods.name: initialize_merge_tool
methods.description: Prepares the environment for using a specific merge tool.

methods.name: run_merge_tool
methods.description: Executes the merge or diff tool based on mode.

methods.name: run_diff_cmd
methods.description: Runs the configured diff command for a tool.

methods.name: run_merge_cmd
methods.description: Runs the merge command for a tool, optionally checking if the merge was successful.

methods.name: list_merge_tool_candidates
methods.description: Builds a list of potential merge tools based on environment and configuration.

methods.name: show_tool_help
methods.description: Displays help information for available tools.

methods.name: guess_merge_tool
methods.description: Guesses a suitable merge tool if none is configured.

methods.name: get_configured_merge_tool
methods.description: Retrieves the merge tool configured in git settings.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_path
methods.description: Finds the path of the merge tool executable.

methods.name: get_merge_tool
methods.description: Determines the merge tool to use, guessing if necessary.

methods.name: mergetool_find_win32_cmd
methods.description: Locates a Windows executable in standard or PATH locations.
